[ilovefullprice] Strange, how is Amazon Prime has anything to do with Apple TV, who are both competitors?
[dongltron] Amazon is a general marketplace product at its core. In fact, a big part of Amazon’s entire approach from the start has been ‘Get on our platform, we’ll advertise your stuff. We take a cut, but you DO make sales.’ Exactly how it worked when Bezos had started it as an online bookstore. He invited competitors to sell their books on Amazon, and Amazon benefitted from it.
At the end of the day, Prime Video is more of a side project to Amazon. Selling subscriptions to other services benefits both platforms inevitably. Selling a product on the biggest online marketplace in the western hemisphere is as much of a no-brainer (in many, but not all cases) as it is to sell your new indie game on Steam. It just makes sense from a business perspective.
